[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Samels''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] soldier who served during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He fought in a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] with [[Kinalos]] and [[Varshin]].<ref name="Author'sCut" />

After the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] successfully reclaimed its former capital, but quickly fell into sectarian infighting after disagreements over who would be proclaimed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]]. Much of the planet was laid waste. After the New Republic reclaimed Coruscant in the aftermath of [[Operation Shadow Hand]], Samels and the [[New Republic Army]] were deployed to clear out remaining Imperial forces. Samels' squad fought through several buildings, among them the [[Unidentified residential building (Coruscant)|ruined home]] of his squadmate [[Kinalos]], though Samels was unaware of this.<ref name="Author'sCut" />
